title: Cipher key used by "Archduke Maximilian" (so the inventory; Archduke Maximilian III died in 1618, so probably Elector Maximilian I of Bavaria) with Albrecht von Wallenstein, Duke of Friedland; and a second, general key
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 169 Rodinný archiv Collaltů Brtnice, I. část, inv. č. 1887
note: MZA inventory: "Šifrovací klíč, kterého užíval arcivévévoda Maxmilian ve styku s vévodou frýdlantským Albrechtem z Valdštejna; druhý šifrovací klíč, všeobecný". Key only. For Wallenstein ciphertexts see Roubík 1931 (Valdštejniana, NA NAD 189).

title: Prussian cipher key used in the Silesian fortresses (copy), Laudon papers
shelfmark: MZA Brno, Rodinný archiv Laudonů, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Gideon Ernst Laudon, Vojenské záležitosti, Sedmiletá válka, inv. č. 73
note: German, 8 fol., copy. Captured or intercepted Prussian key of the Seven Years' War; would fit any intercepted Prussian fortress correspondence of 1758.

title: Cipher keys used by Gottlieb, Ernst Friedrich and Leopold Viktorin Windischgrätz with ministers
shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, Rodinný archiv Windischgrätzů, Oddělení B, Spisy, Říšská dvorní rada - miscellanea, inv. č. 1403 (orig. 103), item 5
note: Keys of the Windischgrätz diplomats (Gottlieb W. was imperial envoy and Reichshofrat president). Check against the repo target windischgraetz1720 and the Windischgrätz-Starhemberg key DECODE R7928.

title: "Cifra numerica" of the Tuscan legation in Paris
shelfmark: Národní archiv, Rodinný archiv toskánských Habsburků - Zastupitelské úřady (NAD 1044/11), inv. č. 56, sig. XXIII/1-55, kart. 44
note: Sub-file "Cifra numerica" in the 1837 files of the Tuscan legation in Paris (finding aid no. 364). Whether ciphertext accompanies it is not stated.

title: Decipherment key ("dešifrovací klíč") filed with Stürmer's despatches from Constantinople, Hudelist papers
shelfmark: Národní archiv, Rodinný archiv Metternichů - Acta Clementina (NAD 611/4), korespondence politická Hoppe, Hudelist, Neumann (finding aid no. 621, A. Haas), p. 9, item of Sept 1818
note: Seen in the scanned finding aid (VadeMeCum, scan 11 of 31): "... Stürmer Metternichovi 1818 1 orig., dešifrovací klíč, Fleischackel Hudelistovi ...". Stürmer was internuncio at the Porte; the key may serve his ciphered reports in HHStA Türkei.

title: Decipherment key for the Metternich-Lieven correspondence (copy), in the bound volumes of Metternich letters to Dorothea Lieven
shelfmark: Národní archiv, Rodinný archiv Metternichů - Acta Clementina (NAD 611/4), korespondence politická Lieven (6th partial inventory, finding aid no. 623), "Correspondance intime du Prince de Metternich 1818-1826", vol. IX, fol. 4
note: Seen in the scanned finding aid (scan 7 of 9): "fol. 4: dešifrovací klíč pro korespondenci Metternich-Lievenová 1822 - opis". The letters are largely printed (Hanoteau 1909 for 1818-19; Quennell 1937 for her side), so a ciphered passage would first be checked against print.

title: List of ciphers used in the Metternich-Floret correspondence
shelfmark: Národní archiv, Rodinný archiv Metternichů - Acta Clementina (NAD 611/4), Osobní věci Klementa Metternicha, inv. č. 322 (14th partial inventory, finding aid no. 1242, p. 35)
note: Seen in the scanned finding aid (scan 41 of 66): "Seznam šifer používaných v korespondenci Metternich-Floret". Engelbert von Floret was Metternich’s secretary of embassy in Paris and later his close aide.
